title: Stronger Models are Not Always Stronger Teachers for Instruction Tuning

live_model.evidence: "AE2 and AH use GPT-4-Turbo (1106) and GPT-4-0314 as the baselines to assess the performance of instruction-tuned models" (AlpacaEval2/Arena-Hard baseline description)

prompt.note: GPT-4-Turbo(1106) is used only as the fixed reference response in the external AlpacaEval2 win-rate protocol, not prompted directly by these authors with a task-specific prompt.

notes: GPT-4-Turbo-1106-preview is retired; the paper's own response generators/teachers are Qwen2/2.5, Llama 3/3.1, Gemma 2, Phi-3, and GPT-4 (undated), none of which is this row's live id.
